test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-5) Official Paper (Held On: 15 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: An equilateral triangle ABC is inscribed in a circle with radius 12 cm and centre O. Find the length of each side of the triangle ABC (in cm).
solution:
**Given:**

Radius of the circle = 12 cm

**Concept used:**

If an equilateral triangle is inscribed in a cirlce then,

r = a/√3

Here,

r = radius of the circle

a = side of the equilateral triangle

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/86d49fccef8e1d25bb91e0df93c817f539980d9585e97560d0bebc786ae60a27.png] 

In ΔABC

AB = BC = CA = side of the equilateral triangle

OA = OC = OB = 12 cm = radius of the circle

Let side of the triangle be a

So, according to the question,

12 = a/√3

⇒ a = 12√3

So, side of the triangle = 12√3 cm

**∴ The length of each side of the triangle ABC (in cm) is 12√3.**
